question: Does my employer have to offer a retirement plan, or a state-run IRA?

nuggets.text: Covered employers must set up a payroll deposit arrangement for MarylandSaves.
nuggets.quote: After the Board opens the Program for enrollment, covered employers shall establish a payroll deposit retirement savings arrangement to allow employee participation in the Program.

nuggets.text: Covered employees are enrolled automatically unless they opt out.
nuggets.quote: A covered employer shall automatically enroll a covered employee in the Program, unless the employee elects to opt out in accordance with procedures established by the Board.

nuggets.text: An employer not in compliance loses the waiver of its annual report filing fee.
nuggets.quote: If a covered employer is not in compliance with subsection (a) of this section, the covered employer may not receive a waiver of the filing fee

nuggets.text: An employer that offers its own savings arrangement is not a covered employer.
nuggets.quote: an employer that currently offers an employer–offered savings arrangement that was established separately from the requirements of this title;
